refs.text_gb: 因为十字架的话，对那正在灭亡的人为愚拙，对我们正在得救的人却为神的大能。
refs.text_big5: 因為十字架的話，對那正在滅亡的人為愚拙，對我們正在得救的人卻為神的大能。
refs.text_en: For the word of the cross is to those who are perishing foolishness, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.

refs.text_gb: 因为无论在那些正在得救的人中，或是在那些正在灭亡的人中，我们都是献给神的基督馨香之气：
refs.text_big5: 因為無論在那些正在得救的人中，或是在那些正在滅亡的人中，我們都是獻給神的基督馨香之氣：
refs.text_en: For we are a fragrance of Christ to God in those who are being saved and in those who are perishing:

verses.text_gb: 在他们里面，[Fn1][Cra]这世代的[Crb]神[Fn2][Crc]弄瞎了他们这不信者的[Fn3][Crd]心思，叫[Fn4]基督[Cre]荣耀之福音的[Crf]光照，不[Fn5]照亮他们；基督本是神的[Crg]像。
verses.text_big5: 在他們裏面，[Fn1][Cra]這世代的[Crb]神[Fn2][Crc]弄瞎了他們這不信者的[Fn3][Crd]心思，叫[Fn4]基督[Cre]榮耀之福音的[Crf]光照，不[Fn5]照亮他們；基督本是神的[Crg]像。
verses.text_en: In whom the god of this age has blinded the thoughts of the unbelievers that the illumination of the gospel of the glory of Christ, who is the image of God, might not shine on them.
verses.text_gb_plain: 在他们里面，这世代的神弄瞎了他们这不信者的心思，叫基督荣耀之福音的光照，不照亮他们；基督本是神的像。
verses.text_big5_plain: 在他們裏面，這世代的神弄瞎了他們這不信者的心思，叫基督榮耀之福音的光照，不照亮他們；基督本是神的像。

footnotes.zh: 指那迷惑者撒但，现今世代的管辖者；他统治着今天的世界，弄瞎人的思想和心思，猎取人的敬拜。
footnotes.zh_big5: 指那迷惑者撒但，現今世代的管轄者；他統治著今天的世界，弄瞎人的思想和心思，獵取人的敬拜。
footnotes.en: 4:4 1 god Satan, the deceiver, the ruler of the present age, who dominates today's world and hunts for man's worship by blinding his mind and his thoughts.

footnotes.zh: 即蒙蔽人的悟性。
footnotes.zh_big5: 即蒙蔽人的悟性。
footnotes.en: 4:4 2 blinded I.e., has veiled men's understanding.

footnotes.zh: 直译，思想。见三14注1。
footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，思想。見三14註1。
footnotes.en: 4:4 3 thoughts Or, minds. See note 2 Cor. 3:14 1 .

footnotes.zh: 基督是神的像，是神荣耀的光辉(来一3)。因此，基督的福音，就是神的荣耀照明并照耀的福音。撒但，这世代的神，弄瞎了不信之人的思想和心思，使基督荣耀之福音的光照，不照进他们心里。这就像照相机的镜头被遮住，光就无法将对象照进照相机里，也像眼瞎或眼受蒙蔽的人，阳光不能照进他里面一样。
footnotes.zh_big5: 基督是神的像，是神榮耀的光輝。（來一3。）因此，基督的福音，就是神的榮耀照明並照耀的福音。撒但，這世代的神，弄瞎了不信之人的思想和心思，使基督榮耀之福音的光照，不照進他們心裏。這就像照相機的鏡頭被遮住，光就無法將對象照進照相機裏，也像眼瞎或眼受蒙蔽的人，陽光不能照進他裏面一樣。
footnotes.en: 4:4 4 illumination Christ as the image of God is the effulgence of His glory (Heb. 1:3). Hence, the gospel of Christ is the gospel of His glory that illuminates and shines forth. Satan, the god of this age, has blinded the thoughts and the minds of the unbelievers so that the illumination of the gospel of Christ's glory might not shine into their hearts. This is similar to a camera lens's being covered so that the light cannot shine into the camera to bring in the image. It is also like a blind man, or a man with his eyes veiled, into whom the light of the sun is unable to shine.

footnotes.zh: 原文意：(一)看清，辨明；(二)照亮。
footnotes.zh_big5: 原文意：(一)看清，辨明；(二)照亮。
footnotes.en: 4:4 5 shine The Greek word means 1) to see distinctly, to discern, 2) to shine.

refs.text_gb: 不要模仿这世代，反要借着心思的更新而变化，叫你们验证何为神那美好、可喜悦、并纯全的旨意。
refs.text_big5: 不要模倣這世代，反要藉著心思的更新而變化，叫你們驗證何為神那美好、可喜悅、並純全的旨意。
refs.text_en: And do not be fashioned according to this age, but be transformed by the renewing of the mind that you may prove what the will of God is, that which is good and well pleasing and perfect.

refs.text_gb: 基督照着我们神与父的旨意，为我们的罪舍了自己，要把我们从现今这邪恶的世代救出来。
refs.text_big5: 基督照著我們神與父的旨意，為我們的罪捨了自己，要把我們從現今這邪惡的世代救出來。
refs.text_en: Who gave Himself for our sins that He might rescue us out of the present evil age according to the will of our God and Father,

refs.text_gb: 现在这世界受审判，这世界的王要被赶出去。
refs.text_big5: 現在這世界受審判，這世界的王要被趕出去。
refs.text_en: Now is the judgment of this world; now shall the ruler of this world be cast out.

refs.text_gb: 那时，你们在其中行事为人，随着这世界的世代，顺着空中掌权者的首领，就是那现今在悖逆之子里面运行之灵的首领；
refs.text_big5: 那時，你們在其中行事為人，隨著這世界的世代，順著空中掌權者的首領，就是那現今在悖逆之子裏面運行之靈的首領；
refs.text_en: In which you once walked according to the age of this world, according to the ruler of the authority of the air, of the spirit which is now operating in the sons of disobedience;

refs.text_gb: 任凭他们吧，他们是瞎子的瞎眼领路者；若是瞎子领瞎子，两个都要掉在坑里。
refs.text_big5: 任憑他們罷，他們是瞎子的瞎眼領路者；若是瞎子領瞎子，兩個都要掉在坑裏。
refs.text_en: Let them be. They are blind guides of the blind; and if a blind man guides a blind man, both will fall into a pit.

refs.text_gb: 瞎眼领路的，你们有祸了！你们说，凡指着殿起誓的，算不得什么；只是凡指着殿中金子起誓的，他就该谨守。
refs.text_big5: 瞎眼領路的，你們有禍了！你們說，凡指著殿起誓的，算不得甚麼；只是凡指著殿中金子起誓的，他就該謹守。
refs.text_en: Woe to you, blind guides, who say, Whoever swears by the temple, it is nothing; but whoever swears by the gold of the temple, he is bound.

refs.text_gb: 愚拙瞎眼的人，哪个是更大的，是金子，还是叫金子成圣的殿？
refs.text_big5: 愚拙瞎眼的人，那個是更大的，是金子，還是叫金子成聖的殿？
refs.text_en: Fools and blind men, which is greater, the gold or the temple which sanctifies the gold?

refs.text_gb: 瞎眼的人，哪个是更大的，是礼物，还是叫礼物成圣的坛？
refs.text_big5: 瞎眼的人，那個是更大的，是禮物，還是叫禮物成聖的壇？
refs.text_en: Blind men, which is greater, the gift or the altar which sanctifies the gift?

refs.text_gb: 瞎眼领路的，蠓虫你们就滤出来，骆驼你们倒吞下去。
refs.text_big5: 瞎眼領路的，蠓蟲你們就濾出來，駱駝你們倒吞下去。
refs.text_en: Blind guides, who strain out the gnat but swallow the camel!

refs.text_gb: 同祂在那里的法利赛人，有的听见这话，就说，难道我们也瞎了眼么？
refs.text_big5: 同祂在那裏的法利賽人，有的聽見這話，就說，難道我們也瞎了眼麼？
refs.text_en: Some of the Pharisees who were with Him heard these things and said to Him, We are not blind also, are we?

refs.text_gb: “主叫他们瞎了眼，硬了心，免得他们眼睛看见，心里明白，回转过来，我就医治他们。”
refs.text_big5: “主叫他們瞎了眼，硬了心，免得他們眼睛看見，心裏明白，回轉過來，我就醫治他們。”
refs.text_en: "He has blinded their eyes and He hardened their heart, that they might not see with their eyes and understand with their heart and turn, and I will heal them."

refs.text_gb: 你要使这百姓心蒙脂油，耳朵发沉，眼睛封闭；恐怕他们眼睛看见，耳朵听见，心里领悟，回转过来，便得医治。
refs.text_big5: 你要使這百姓心蒙脂油，耳朵發沉，眼睛封閉；恐怕他們眼睛看見，耳朵聽見，心裏領悟，回轉過來，便得醫治。
refs.text_en: Make the heart of this people numb; / Dull their ears, / And seal their eyes; / Lest they see with their eyes and hear with their ears, / And their heart perceive and return, and they are healed.

refs.text_gb: 但他们的心思刚硬，因为直到今日他们诵读旧约的时候，同样的帕子还存留着，他们还未得启示这帕子在基督里已经废去了。
refs.text_big5: 但他們的心思剛硬，因為直到今日他們誦讀舊約的時候，同樣的帕子還存留著，他們還未得啟示這帕子在基督裏已經廢去了。
refs.text_en: But their thoughts were hardened; for until the present day the same veil remains at the reading of the old covenant, it not being unveiled to them that the veil is being done away with in Christ.

refs.text_gb: 何况那灵的职事，岂不更带着荣光？
refs.text_big5: 何況那靈的職事，豈不更帶著榮光？
refs.text_en: How shall the ministry of the Spirit not be more in glory?

refs.text_gb: 若定罪的职事有荣光，那称义的职事，就越发充盈着荣光了。
refs.text_big5: 若定罪的職事有榮光，那稱義的職事，就越發充盈著榮光了。
refs.text_en: For if there is glory with the ministry of condemnation, much more the ministry of righteousness abounds with glory.

refs.text_gb: 那从前得荣光的，在这一点上，因这超越的荣光，就算不得有荣光；
refs.text_big5: 那從前得榮光的，在這一點上，因這超越的榮光，就算不得有榮光；
refs.text_en: For also that which has been glorified in this respect has not been glorified on account of the surpassing glory.

refs.text_gb: 因为那渐渐废去的，如果是经过荣光的，这长存的就更多在荣光里了。
refs.text_big5: 因為那漸漸廢去的，如果是經過榮光的，這長存的就更多在榮光裏了。
refs.text_en: For if that which was being done away with was through glory, much more that which remains is in glory.

refs.text_gb: 但我们众人既然以没有帕子遮蔽的脸，好像镜子观看并返照主的荣光，就渐渐变化成为与祂同样的形像，从荣耀到荣耀，乃是从主灵变化成的。
refs.text_big5: 但我們眾人既然以沒有帕子遮蔽的臉，好像鏡子觀看並返照主的榮光，就漸漸變化成為與祂同樣的形像，從榮耀到榮耀，乃是從主靈變化成的。
refs.text_en: But we all with unveiled face, beholding and reflecting like a mirror the glory of the Lord, are being transformed into the same image from glory to glory, even as from the Lord Spirit.

refs.text_gb: 因为那说光要从黑暗里照出来的神，已经照在我们心里，为着光照人，使人认识那显在耶稣基督面上之神的荣耀。
refs.text_big5: 因為那說光要從黑暗裏照出來的神，已經照在我們心裏，為著光照人，使人認識那顯在耶穌基督面上之神的榮耀。
refs.text_en: Because the God who said, Out of darkness light shall shine, is the One who shined in our hearts to illuminate the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.

refs.text_gb: 爱子是那不能看见之神的像，是一切受造之物的首生者。
refs.text_big5: 愛子是那不能看見之神的像，是一切受造之物的首生者。
refs.text_en: Who is the image of the invisible God, the Firstborn of all creation,

refs.text_gb: 祂是神荣耀的光辉，是神本质的印像，用祂大能的话维持、载着并推动万有；祂成就了洗罪的事，就坐在高处至尊至大者的右边；
refs.text_big5: 祂是神榮耀的光輝，是神本質的印像，用祂大能的話維持、載著並推動萬有；祂成就了洗罪的事，就坐在高處至尊至大者的右邊；
refs.text_en: Who, being the effulgence of His glory and the impress of His substance and upholding and bearing all things by the word of His power, having made purification of sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high;

verses.text_gb: [Fn1]因为我们不是传自己，乃是[Cra]传基督耶稣为[Fn2][Crb]主，也传自己为耶稣的缘故，作你们的[Fn3][Crc]奴仆。
verses.text_big5: [Fn1]因為我們不是傳自己，乃是[Cra]傳基督耶穌為[Fn2][Crb]主，也傳自己為耶穌的緣故，作你們的[Fn3][Crc]奴僕。
verses.text_en: For we do not preach ourselves but Christ Jesus as Lord, and ourselves as your slaves for Jesus' sake.
verses.text_gb_plain: 因为我们不是传自己，乃是传基督耶稣为主，也传自己为耶稣的缘故，作你们的奴仆。
verses.text_big5_plain: 因為我們不是傳自己，乃是傳基督耶穌為主，也傳自己為耶穌的緣故，作你們的奴僕。

footnotes.zh: “因为”说明使徒的福音，就是他们所传基督之荣耀的福音，为何不该受蒙蔽，因为他们不是传自己，高举自己，乃是传基督耶稣为万有的主，也传他们为耶稣的缘故，作信徒的奴仆。
footnotes.zh_big5: “因為”說明使徒的福音，就是他們所傳基督之榮耀的福音，為何不該受蒙蔽，因為他們不是傳自己，高舉自己，乃是傳基督耶穌為萬有的主，也傳他們為耶穌的緣故，作信徒的奴僕。
footnotes.en: 4:5 1 For This explains why the apostles' gospel, which is the gospel of the glory of Christ, should not have been veiled: they did not preach, exalt, themselves but Christ Jesus as Lord of all, and they conducted themselves as the believers' slaves for Jesus' sake.

footnotes.zh: 基督耶稣为主，包含：基督是在万有之上，永远受颂赞的神(罗九5)；永远的话成了肉体，成了人(约一14)；耶稣是人钉十字架，成了我们的救主(徒四10～12)，并且复活，成了神的儿子(徒十三33)；基督被高举为主(徒二36)，就是万人的主(徒十36，罗十12，约二十28，林前十二3)；祂是神的像，是神荣耀的光辉(来一3)。这就是福音的内容。因此，福音乃是基督荣耀的福音，照明、照射、照耀在人心里(6)。人的心若不受任何事物遮蔽，也不被撒但这世代的神弄瞎，他就能看见福音的光照(4)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 基督耶穌為主，包含：基督是在萬有之上，永遠受頌讚的神；（羅九5；）永遠的話成了肉體，成了人；（約一14；）耶穌是人釘十字架，成了我們的救主，（徒四10～12，）並且復活，成了神的兒子；（徒十三33；）基督被高舉為主，（徒二36，）就是萬人的主；（徒十36，羅十12，約二十28，林前十二3；）祂是神的像，是神榮耀的光輝。（來一3。）這就是福音的內容。因此，福音乃是基督榮耀的福音，照明、照射、照耀在人心裏。（6。）人的心若不受任何事物遮蔽，也不被撒但這世代的神弄瞎，他就能看見福音的光照。（4。）
footnotes.en: 4:5 2 Lord Christ Jesus as Lord comprises Christ, who is over all, God blessed forever (Rom. 9:5), the eternal Word incarnated to be a man (John 1:14), Jesus crucified as a man to be our Savior (Acts 4:10-12) and resurrected to be the Son of God (Acts 13:33), and Christ exalted to be the Lord (Acts 2:36), even the Lord of all men (Acts 10:36; Rom. 10:12; John 20:28; 1 Cor. 12:3), who is the image of God, the effulgence of God's glory (Heb. 1:3). This is the very content of the gospel. Hence, the gospel is the gospel of the glory of Christ, which illuminates, radiates, and shines in the heart of man (v. 6). If man's heart is not veiled with anything or blinded by Satan, the god of this age, man can see the illumination of the gospel (v. 4).

footnotes.zh: 与主相对。使徒高举基督为主，却认为自己不过是服事信徒的奴仆。
footnotes.zh_big5: 與主相對。使徒高舉基督為主，卻認為自己不過是服事信徒的奴僕。
footnotes.en: 4:5 3 slaves In contrast to Lord. The apostles exalted Christ as Lord but considered themselves merely slaves to serve the believers.

refs.text_gb: 我们却是传扬钉十字架的基督，对犹太人为绊脚石，对外邦人为愚拙；
refs.text_big5: 我們卻是傳揚釘十字架的基督，對猶太人為絆腳石，對外邦人為愚拙；
refs.text_en: But we preach Christ crucified, to Jews a stumbling block, and to Gentiles foolishness,

refs.text_gb: 在我们却只有一位神，就是父，万物都本于祂，我们也归于祂；并有一位主，就是耶稣基督，万物都是借着祂有的，我们也是借着祂有的。
refs.text_big5: 在我們卻只有一位神，就是父，萬物都本於祂，我們也歸於祂；並有一位主，就是耶穌基督，萬物都是藉著祂有的，我們也是藉著祂有的。
refs.text_en: Yet to us there is one God, the Father, out from whom are all things, and we are unto Him; and one Lord, Jesus Christ, through whom are all things, and we are through Him.

refs.text_gb: 所以我要你们知道，在神的灵里说话的，没有人说，受咒诅的，耶稣！若不是在圣灵里，也没有人能说，主，耶稣！
refs.text_big5: 所以我要你們知道，在神的靈裏說話的，沒有人說，受咒詛的，耶穌！若不是在聖靈裏，也沒有人能說，主，耶穌！
refs.text_en: Therefore I make known to you that no one speaking in the Spirit of God says, Jesus is accursed; and no one can say, Jesus is Lord! except in the Holy Spirit.

refs.text_gb: 我虽从众人得了自由，却自愿奴役于众人，为要多得人。
refs.text_big5: 我雖從眾人得了自由，卻自願奴役於眾人，為要多得人。
refs.text_en: For though I am free from all, I have enslaved myself to all that I might gain the more.

verses.text_gb: [Fn1]因为那说[Cra]光要从[Crb]黑暗里照出来的神，已经照[Fn2]在[Fn3]我们[Crc]心里，为着[Fn4][Crd]光照人，使人认识那显在耶稣[Fn5]基督面上之神的[Cre]荣耀。
verses.text_big5: [Fn1]因為那說[Cra]光要從[Crb]黑暗裏照出來的神，已經照[Fn2]在[Fn3]我們[Crc]心裏，為著[Fn4][Crd]光照人，使人認識那顯在耶穌[Fn5]基督面上之神的[Cre]榮耀。
verses.text_en: Because the God who said, Out of darkness light shall shine, is the One who shined in our hearts to illuminate the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.
verses.text_gb_plain: 因为那说光要从黑暗里照出来的神，已经照在我们心里，为着光照人，使人认识那显在耶稣基督面上之神的荣耀。
verses.text_big5_plain: 因為那說光要從黑暗裏照出來的神，已經照在我們心裏，為著光照人，使人認識那顯在耶穌基督面上之神的榮耀。

footnotes.zh: 这是解释前节所说的。使徒传基督为主，也传他们作信徒的奴仆，因为那说，光要从黑暗里照出来的神，已经照在他们心里。神照在宇宙中，产生了旧造；现今神照在他们心里，使他们成为新造。所以，他们能在他们的传讲中高举基督为主，也在他们的职事中降卑自己作信徒的奴仆。他们为基督所作的，并他们向信徒所是的，乃是神照耀的结果。神的照耀产生了新约的众执事，和他们的职事。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這是解釋前節所說的。使徒傳基督為主，也傳他們作信徒的奴僕，因為那說，光要從黑暗裏照出來的神，已經照在他們心裏。神照在宇宙中，產生了舊造；現今神照在他們心裏，使他們成為新造。所以，他們能在他們的傳講中高舉基督為主，也在他們的職事中降卑自己作信徒的奴僕。他們為基督所作的，並他們向信徒所是的，乃是神照耀的結果。神的照耀產生了新約的眾執事，和他們的職事。
footnotes.en: 4:6 1 Because This explains what is mentioned in the preceding verse. The apostles preached Christ as Lord and themselves as the believers' slaves because the very God who commanded light to shine out of darkness had shined in their hearts. His shining in the universe produced the old creation. Now His shining in their hearts made them a new creation. Therefore, in their preaching they were able to exalt Christ as the Lord, and in their ministry, to conduct themselves as slaves of the believers. What they did for Christ and what they were to the believers were the issue of God's shining. God's shining produces the new covenant ministers and their ministry.

footnotes.zh: 在我们心里，比在摩西面皮上深多了(三7，出三四29～30)。这给我们看见，使徒福音职事的荣光和摩西律法职事的荣光，二者之间的比较。在心里，与里面的生命有关；在面皮上，与里面的生命无关。旧约的荣光是在表面上，但新约的荣光是极有深度的。
footnotes.zh_big5: 在我們心裏，比在摩西面皮上深多了。（三7，出三四29～30。）這給我們看見，使徒福音職事的榮光和摩西律法職事的榮光，二者之間的比較。在心裏，與裏面的生命有關；在面皮上，與裏面的生命無關。舊約的榮光是在表面上，但新約的榮光是極有深度的。
footnotes.en: 4:6 2 in In our hearts is much deeper than on the skin of Moses' face (2 Cor. 3:7; Exo. 34:29-30). This presents a comparison between the glory of the apostolic ministry of the gospel and that of the Mosaic ministry of the law. In the heart is related to the inner life, whereas on the skin of the face has nothing to do with the inner life. The glory of the old covenant is on the surface, but the glory of the new covenant has great depth.

footnotes.zh: 指使徒的心。他们代表新约所有的信徒。
footnotes.zh_big5: 指使徒的心。他們代表新約所有的信徒。
footnotes.en: 4:6 3 our The apostles' hearts. The apostles represent all the believers of the new covenant.

footnotes.zh: 这里的光照，指神的光从那些心里蒙神光照的人，发光照耀别人，与2节的显扬相合，也与太五16的照，并腓二15的显相同。神照在我们心里，为叫我们光照别人，使他们认识神显在基督面上的荣耀，也就是认识那彰显神，表明神的基督(约一18)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這裏的光照，指神的光從那些心裏蒙神光照的人，發光照耀別人，與2節的顯揚相合，也與太五16的照，並腓二15的顯相同。神照在我們心裏，為叫我們光照別人，使他們認識神顯在基督面上的榮耀，也就是認識那彰顯神，表明神的基督。（約一18。）
footnotes.en: 4:6 4 illuminate The illumination here, which refers to the shining of God's light on others out from those whose hearts have been enlightened by God, corresponds with the manifestation in v. 2 and is the same as the shining in Matt. 5:16 and Phil. 2:15. God shines in our hearts that we may shine on others so that they may have the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ, that is, the knowledge of Christ, who expresses and declares God (John 1:18).

footnotes.zh: 基督的面是与摩西的面相比(三7)。在基督面上福音的荣光，远比在摩西面上律法的荣光卓越。前者照在恩典和实际借着祂而来者的面上，结果乃是义和那灵——生命(三8～9)；后者照在律法借着他而赐者的面上(约一17)，结果乃是定罪和死(三7，9)。神照在我们心里，光照我们，不是使我们认识摩西面上的荣光，乃是使我们认识基督面上的荣耀；祂照明我们，不是使我们认识旧约摩西的律法，乃是使我们认识新约基督的福音。显在耶稣基督面上之神的荣耀，就是耶稣基督所彰显那荣耀的神，也就是那是神荣耀之光辉的耶稣基督(来一3)；认识祂，也就是认识那荣耀的神。
footnotes.zh_big5: 基督的面是與摩西的面相比。（三7。）在基督面上福音的榮光，遠比在摩西面上律法的榮光卓越。前者照在恩典和實際藉著祂而來者的面上，結果乃是義和那靈－生命；（三8～9；）後者照在律法藉著他而賜者的面上，（約一17，）結果乃是定罪和死。（三7，9。）神照在我們心裏，光照我們，不是使我們認識摩西面上的榮光，乃是使我們認識基督面上的榮耀；祂照明我們，不是使我們認識舊約摩西的律法，乃是使我們認識新約基督的福音。顯在耶穌基督面上之神的榮耀，就是耶穌基督所彰顯那榮耀的神，也就是那是神榮耀之光輝的耶穌基督；（來一3；）認識祂，也就是認識那榮耀的神。
footnotes.en: 4:6 5 face The face of Jesus Christ is in comparison with the face of Moses (2 Cor. 3:7). The glory of the gospel in the face of Jesus Christ is much superior to the glory of the law in the face of Moses. The former shines in the face of One through whom grace and reality came, issuing in righteousness and the Spirit — life (2 Cor. 3:8-9); the latter shone in the face of one through whom the law was given (John 1:17), resulting in condemnation and death (2 Cor. 3:7, 9). The shining of God in our hearts is to illumine us that we may know not the glory on Moses' face but the glory in Christ's face; it is to enlighten us that we may know not the law of Moses of the old covenant but the gospel of Christ of the new covenant. The glory of God manifested in the face of Jesus Christ is the God of glory expressed through Jesus Christ, and it is Jesus Christ, who is the effulgence of the glory of God (Heb. 1:3); to know Him is to know the God of glory.

refs.text_gb: 但你的眼睛若不专，全身就黑暗。所以你里面的光若黑暗了，那黑暗是何等的大！
refs.text_big5: 但你的眼睛若不專，全身就黑暗。所以你裏面的光若黑暗了，那黑暗是何等的大！
refs.text_en: But if your eye is evil, your whole body will be dark. If then the light that is in you is darkness, how great is the darkness!

refs.text_gb: 光照在黑暗里，黑暗未曾胜过光。
refs.text_big5: 光照在黑暗裏，黑暗未曾勝過光。
refs.text_en: And the light shines in the darkness, and the darkness did not overcome it.

refs.text_gb: 于是耶稣又对众人讲论说，我是世界的光，跟从我的，就绝不在黑暗里行，必要得着生命的光。
refs.text_big5: 於是耶穌又對眾人講論說，我是世界的光，跟從我的，就絕不在黑暗裏行，必要得著生命的光。
refs.text_en: Again therefore Jesus spoke to them, saying, I am the light of the world; he who follows Me shall by no means walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣就对他们说，光在你们中间，还有不多的时候，应当趁着有光行走，免得黑暗胜过你们；那在黑暗里行走的，不知道往何处去。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌就對他們說，光在你們中間，還有不多的時候，應當趁著有光行走，免得黑暗勝過你們；那在黑暗裏行走的，不知道往何處去。
refs.text_en: Jesus then said to them, The light is still among you a little while. Walk while you have the light so that darkness may not overcome you; and he who walks in the darkness does not know where he is going.

refs.text_gb: 我到世上来作光，叫一切信入我的，不住在黑暗里。
refs.text_big5: 我到世上來作光，叫一切信入我的，不住在黑暗裏。
refs.text_en: I have come as a light into the world, that everyone who believes into Me would not remain in darkness.

refs.text_gb: 我差你到他们那里去，叫他们的眼睛得开，从黑暗转入光中，从撒但权下转向神，又因信入我，得蒙赦罪，并在一切圣别的人中得着基业。
refs.text_big5: 我差你到他們那裏去，叫他們的眼睛得開，從黑暗轉入光中，從撒但權下轉向神，又因信入我，得蒙赦罪，並在一切聖別的人中得著基業。
refs.text_en: To open their eyes, to turn them from darkness to light and from the authority of Satan to God, that they may receive forgiveness of sins and an inheritance among those who have been sanctified by faith in Me.

refs.text_gb: 你们跟不信的，不要不配的同负一轭，因为义和不法有什么合伙？光对黑暗有什么交通？
refs.text_big5: 你們跟不信的，不要不配的同負一軛，因為義和不法有甚麼合夥？光對黑暗有甚麼交通？
refs.text_en: Do not become dissimilarly yoked with unbelievers. For what partnership do righteousness and lawlessness have? Or what fellowship does light have with darkness?

refs.text_gb: 你们从前是黑暗，但如今在主里面乃是光，行事为人就要像光的儿女，
refs.text_big5: 你們從前是黑暗，但如今在主裏面乃是光，行事為人就要像光的兒女，
refs.text_en: For you were once darkness but are now light in the Lord; walk as children of light

refs.text_gb: 因我们并不是与血肉之人摔跤，乃是与那些执政的、掌权的、管辖这黑暗世界的、以及诸天界里那邪恶的属灵势力摔跤。
refs.text_big5: 因我們並不是與血肉之人摔跤，乃是與那些執政的、掌權的、管轄這黑暗世界的、以及諸天界裏那邪惡的屬靈勢力摔跤。
refs.text_en: For our wrestling is not against blood and flesh but against the rulers, against the authorities, against the world-rulers of this darkness, against the spiritual forces of evil in the heavenlies.

refs.text_gb: 祂拯救了我们脱离黑暗的权势，把我们迁入祂爱子的国里；
refs.text_big5: 祂拯救了我們脫離黑暗的權勢，把我們遷入祂愛子的國裏；
refs.text_en: Who delivered us out of the authority of darkness and transferred us into the kingdom of the Son of His love,

refs.text_gb: 因为你们都是光明之子和白昼之子。我们不是属黑夜的，也不是属黑暗的。
refs.text_big5: 因為你們都是光明之子和白晝之子。我們不是屬黑夜的，也不是屬黑暗的。
refs.text_en: For you are all sons of light and sons of the day. We are not of the night nor of darkness.

refs.text_gb: 唯有你们是蒙拣选的族类，是君尊的祭司体系，是圣别的国度，是买来作产业的子民，要叫你们宣扬那召你们出黑暗、入祂奇妙之光者的美德；
refs.text_big5: 惟有你們是蒙揀選的族類，是君尊的祭司體系，是聖別的國度，是買來作產業的子民，要叫你們宣揚那召你們出黑暗、入祂奇妙之光者的美德；
refs.text_en: But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people acquired for a possession, so that you may tell out the virtues of Him who has called you out of darkness into His marvelous light;

refs.text_gb: 神就是光，在祂里面毫无黑暗；这是我们从祂所听见，现在又报给你们的信息。
refs.text_big5: 神就是光，在祂裏面毫無黑暗；這是我們從祂所聽見，現在又報給你們的信息。
refs.text_en: And this is the message which we have heard from Him and announce to you, that God is light and in Him is no darkness at all.

refs.text_gb: 再者，我写给你们的是一条新诫命，这在主并在你们都是真的；因为黑暗渐渐过去，真光已经照耀。

refs.text_en: Yet again a new commandment I am writing to you, which is true in Him and in you because the darkness is passing away and the true light is already shining.

refs.text_gb: 我们并有申言者更确定的话，你们留意这话，如同留意照在暗处的灯，直等到天发亮，晨星在你们心里出现，你们就作得好了；
refs.text_big5: 我們並有申言者更確定的話，你們留意這話，如同留意照在暗處的燈，直等到天發亮，晨星在你們心裏出現，你們就作得好了；
refs.text_en: And we have the prophetic word made more firm, to which you do well to give heed as to a lamp shining in a dark place, until the day dawns and the morning star rises in your hearts;

refs.text_gb: 在他们里面，这世代的神弄瞎了他们这不信者的心思，叫基督荣耀之福音的光照，不照亮他们；基督本是神的像。

refs.text_en: In whom the god of this age has blinded the thoughts of the unbelievers that the illumination of the gospel of the glory of Christ, who is the image of God, might not shine on them.

refs.text_gb: 何况那灵的职事，岂不更带着荣光？

refs.text_en: For if there is glory with the ministry of condemnation, much more the ministry of righteousness abounds with glory.

refs.text_gb: 那从前得荣光的，在这一点上，因这超越的荣光，就算不得有荣光；
refs.text_big5: 那從前得榮光的，在這一點上，因這超越的榮光，就算不得有榮光；
refs.text_en: For also that which has been glorified in this respect has not been glorified on account of the surpassing glory.

refs.text_gb: 因为那渐渐废去的，如果是经过荣光的，这长存的就更多在荣光里了。
refs.text_big5: 因為那漸漸廢去的，如果是經過榮光的，這長存的就更多在榮光裏了。
refs.text_en: For if that which was being done away with was through glory, much more that which remains is in glory.

refs.text_en: But we all with unveiled face, beholding and reflecting like a mirror the glory of the Lord, are being transformed into the same image from glory to glory, even as from the Lord Spirit.

verses.text_gb: [Fn1]但我们有这[Fn2][Cra]宝贝在瓦[Crb]器里，要显明这[Fn3][Crc]超越的[Crd]能力，是属于神，不是出于我们；

verses.text_en: But we have this treasure in earthen vessels that the excellency of the power may be of God and not out of us.
verses.text_gb_plain: 但我们有这宝贝在瓦器里，要显明这超越的能力，是属于神，不是出于我们；
verses.text_big5_plain: 但我們有這寶貝在瓦器裏，要顯明這超越的能力，是屬於神，不是出於我們；

footnotes.zh: 神照在我们心里，带给我们一个宝贝，就是那是神的具体化身，作了我们的生命和一切之荣耀的基督。但我们盛装这宝贝的，却是没有价值且脆弱的瓦器。无价之宝竟盛装在没有价值的器皿里！这使没有价值的器皿成为新约的众执事，有无上宝贵的职事。这乃是借着在复活里的神圣能力。这超越的能力必是属于神，不是出于我们。 使徒说到他们为着神的新约尽职时，用了五个极其重要，意义深长的隐喻，说明他们这些新约的执事和他们的职事，是如何构成的，他们是如何行事并生活的，以及他们的职事是如何完成的：(一)凯旋行列中的俘虏，庆祝基督的得胜(二14上)；(二)带着香的人，散放基督的香气(二14下～16)；(三)用基督为内容所写的信(三1～3)；(四)观看并返照基督荣耀的镜子，为要渐渐变化成为祂荣耀的形像(三18)；(五)盛装荣耀基督这超越宝贝的瓦器(7)。这些器皿就像今日的照相机，让基督这对象借着神的照耀(4，6)，照进里面。
footnotes.zh_big5: 神照在我們心裏，帶給我們一個寶貝，就是那是神的具體化身，作了我們的生命和一切之榮耀的基督。但我們盛裝這寶貝的，卻是沒有價值且脆弱的瓦器。無價之寶竟盛裝在沒有價值的器皿裏！這使沒有價值的器皿成為新約的眾執事，有無上寶貴的職事。這乃是藉著在復活裏的神聖能力。這超越的能力必是屬於神，不是出於我們。ˍ使徒說到他們為著神的新約盡職時，用了五個極其重要，意義深長的隱喻，說明他們這些新約的執事和他們的職事，是如何構成的，他們是如何行事並生活的，以及他們的職事是如何完成的：(一)凱旋行列中的俘虜，慶祝基督的得勝；（二14上；）(二)帶著香的人，散放基督的香氣；（二14下～16；）(三)用基督為內容所寫的信；（三1～3；）(四)觀看並返照基督榮耀的鏡子，為要漸漸變化成為祂榮耀的形像；（三18；）(五)盛裝榮耀基督這超越寶貝的瓦器。（7。）這些器皿就像今日的照相機，讓基督這對象藉著神的照耀，（4，6，）照進裏面。
footnotes.en: 4:7 1 But God's shining in our hearts brings into us a treasure, the Christ of glory, who is the embodiment of God to be our life and our everything. But we who contain this treasure are earthen vessels, worthless and fragile. A priceless treasure is contained in worthless vessels! This has made the worthless vessels ministers of the new covenant with a priceless ministry. This has been accomplished by the divine power in resurrection. The excellency of the power is surely of God and not out of us. In the apostles' speaking concerning their ministry for God's new covenant, five very significant and expressive metaphors were used to illustrate how they, as the ministers of the new covenant, and their ministry were constituted, how they behaved and lived, and how their ministry was carried out: 1) Captives in a triumphal procession for the celebration of Christ's victory (2 Cor. 2:14a); 2) Incense-bearers to scatter the fragrance of Christ (2 Cor. 2:14-16); 3) Letters written with Christ as the content (2 Cor. 3:1-3); 4) Mirrors beholding and reflecting the glory of Christ in order to be transformed into His glorious image (2 Cor. 3:18); 5) Earthen vessels to contain the Christ of glory as the excellent treasure (v. 7). These vessels are like today's camera, into which Christ the figure enters through the flash of God's shining (vv. 4, 6).

footnotes.zh: 这宝贝，内住的基督，在我们这些瓦器里，乃是基督徒生活神圣供应的源头。作新约执事的使徒，靠这宝贝超越的能力，就能过钉十字架的生活，使他们所供应基督复活的生命得以显明。因此，他们将真理显扬出来(2)，使福音得以照耀。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這寶貝，內住的基督，在我們這些瓦器裏，乃是基督徒生活神聖供應的源頭。作新約執事的使徒，靠這寶貝超越的能力，就能過釘十字架的生活，使他們所供應基督復活的生命得以顯明。因此，他們將真理顯揚出來，（2，）使福音得以照耀。
footnotes.en: 4:7 2 treasure This treasure, the indwelling Christ, in us, the earthen vessels, is the divine source of the supply for the Christian life. It is by the excellent power of this treasure that the apostles as the ministers of the new covenant were capable of living a crucified life that the resurrection life of Christ, whom they ministered, might be manifested. Thus, they manifested the truth (v. 2) for the shining of the gospel.

footnotes.zh: 或，超绝，优越，极大。
footnotes.zh_big5: 或，超絕，優越，極大。
footnotes.en: 4:7 3 excellency Or, transcendence, surpassing greatness, exceeding greatness.

refs.text_gb: 因为你的财宝在那里，你的心也必在那里。
refs.text_big5: 因為你的財寶在那裏，你的心也必在那裏。
refs.text_en: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.

refs.text_gb: 诸天的国好像宝贝藏在田地里，人找到了，就藏起来，欢欢喜喜地去变卖他一切所有的，买这田地。
refs.text_big5: 諸天的國好像寶貝藏在田地裏，人找到了，就藏起來，歡歡喜喜的去變賣他一切所有的，買這田地。
refs.text_en: The kingdom of the heavens is like a treasure hidden in the field, which a man found and hid, and in his joy goes and sells all that he has, and buys that field.

refs.text_gb: 窑匠难道没有权柄，从同一团泥里，拿一块作成贵重的器皿，又拿一块作成卑贱的器皿么？
refs.text_big5: 窯匠難道沒有權柄，從同一團泥裏，拿一塊作成貴重的器皿，又拿一塊作成卑賤的器皿麼？
refs.text_en: Or does not the potter have authority over the clay to make out of the same lump one vessel unto honor and another unto dishonor?

refs.text_gb: 且要在那些蒙怜悯、早预备得荣耀的器皿上，彰显祂荣耀的丰富；
refs.text_big5: 且要在那些蒙憐憫、早豫備得榮耀的器皿上，彰顯祂榮耀的豐富；
refs.text_en: In order that He might make known the riches of His glory upon vessels of mercy, which He had before prepared unto glory,

refs.text_gb: 锡安宝贵的众子，好比精金，现在何竟算为窑匠的手所作的瓦瓶。
refs.text_big5: 錫安寶貴的眾子，好比精金，現在何竟算為窯匠的手所作的瓦瓶。
refs.text_en: The precious sons of Zion, / Comparable to fine gold, / How they are esteemed as earthen pitchers, / The work of the hands of a potter.

refs.text_gb: 但在大户人家，不但有金器银器，也有木器瓦器；有作为贵重的，也有作为卑贱的；
refs.text_big5: 但在大戶人家，不但有金器銀器，也有木器瓦器；有作為貴重的，也有作為卑賤的；
refs.text_en: But in a great house there are not only gold and silver vessels but also wooden and earthen; and some are unto honor, and some unto dishonor.

refs.text_gb: 不但如此，我也将万事看作亏损，因我以认识我主基督耶稣为至宝；我因祂已经亏损万事，看作粪土，为要赢得基督，
refs.text_big5: 不但如此，我也將萬事看作虧損，因我以認識我主基督耶穌為至寶；我因祂已經虧損萬事，看作糞土，為要贏得基督，
refs.text_en: But moreover I also count all things to be loss on account of the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord, on account of whom I have suffered the loss of all things and count them as refuse that I may gain Christ

refs.text_gb: 我说的话，讲的道，不是用智慧动听的言语，乃是用那灵和能力的明证，
refs.text_big5: 我說的話，講的道，不是用智慧動聽的言語，乃是用那靈和能力的明證，
refs.text_en: And my speech and my proclamation were not in persuasive words of wisdom but in demonstration of the Spirit and of power,

refs.text_gb: 以及祂的能力向着我们这信的人，照祂力量之权能的运行，是何等超越的浩大，
refs.text_big5: 以及祂的能力向著我們這信的人，照祂力量之權能的運行，是何等超越的浩大，
refs.text_en: And what is the surpassing greatness of His power toward us who believe, according to the operation of the might of His strength,

refs.text_gb: 我作了这福音的执事，是照着神恩典的恩赐，这恩赐是照着祂大能的运行所赐给我的。
refs.text_big5: 我作了這福音的執事，是照著神恩典的恩賜，這恩賜是照著祂大能的運行所賜給我的。
refs.text_en: Of which I became a minister according to the gift of the grace of God which was given to me according to the operation of His power.

refs.text_gb: 然而神能照着运行在我们里面的大能，极其充盈的成就一切，超过我们所求所想的；
refs.text_big5: 然而神能照著運行在我們裏面的大能，極其充盈的成就一切，超過我們所求所想的；
refs.text_en: But to Him who is able to do superabundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power which operates in us,

refs.text_gb: 我也为此劳苦，照着祂在我里面大能的运行，竭力奋斗。
refs.text_big5: 我也為此勞苦，照著祂在我裏面大能的運行，竭力奮鬥。
refs.text_en: For which also I labor, struggling according to His operation which operates in me in power.

verses.text_gb: 我们[Fn1][Cra]四面受压，却不被[Fn2]困住；出路绝了，却非[Crb]绝无出路；
verses.text_big5: 我們[Fn1][Cra]四面受壓，卻不被[Fn2]困住；出路絕了，卻非[Crb]絕無出路；
verses.text_en: We are pressed on every side but not constricted; unable to find a way out but not utterly without a way out;
verses.text_gb_plain: 我们四面受压，却不被困住；出路绝了，却非绝无出路；
verses.text_big5_plain: 我們四面受壓，卻不被困住；出路絕了，卻非絕無出路；

footnotes.zh: 或，各面遭难。本节至18节描述使徒的生活，表明他们在复活里过钉十字架的生活，或在十字架的杀死下，活出复活的生命，为着完成他们的职事。
footnotes.zh_big5: 或，各面遭難。8～18節描述使徒的生活，表明他們在復活裏過釘十字架的生活，或在十字架的殺死下，活出復活的生命，為著完成他們的職事。
footnotes.en: 4:8 1 pressed Or, afflicted. The description of their life, from this verse through v. 18, shows that the apostles lived a crucified life in resurrection, or lived the resurrection life under the killing of the cross, for the carrying out of their ministry.

footnotes.zh: 或，限制。
footnotes.zh_big5: 或，限制。
footnotes.en: 4:8 2 constricted Or, restricted.

refs.text_gb: 原来我们就是到了马其顿，我们的肉身也不得安宁，反而凡事遭患难，外有争战，内有惧怕。
refs.text_big5: 原來我們就是到了馬其頓，我們的肉身也不得安寧，反而凡事遭患難，外有爭戰，內有懼怕。
refs.text_en: For even when we came into Macedonia, our flesh had no rest, but we were afflicted in everything; without were fightings, within were fears.

refs.text_gb: 弟兄们，关于我们在亚西亚所遭遇的患难，我们不愿意你们不知道，就是我们被压太重，力不能胜，甚至连活命的指望都绝了，
refs.text_big5: 弟兄們，關於我們在亞西亞所遭遇的患難，我們不願意你們不知道，就是我們被壓太重，力不能勝，甚至連活命的指望都絕了，
refs.text_en: For we do not want you to be ignorant, brothers, of our affliction which befell us in Asia, that we were excessively burdened, beyond our power, so that we despaired even of living.

verses.text_gb: [Fn1][Cra]遭逼迫，却不被[Fn2][Crb]撇弃；打倒了，却[Crc]不至[Fn3]灭亡；
verses.text_big5: [Fn1][Cra]遭逼迫，卻不被[Fn2][Crb]撇棄；打倒了，卻[Crc]不至[Fn3]滅亡；
verses.text_en: Persecuted but not abandoned; cast down but not destroyed;
verses.text_gb_plain: 遭逼迫，却不被撇弃；打倒了，却不至灭亡；
verses.text_big5_plain: 遭逼迫，卻不被撇棄；打倒了，卻不至滅亡；

footnotes.zh: 或，被(仇敌)追赶。
footnotes.zh_big5: 或，被（仇敵）追趕。
footnotes.en: 4:9 1 Persecuted Or, pursued (by enemies).

footnotes.zh: 或，遗弃，弃绝。直译，撇下(在恶劣的困境中)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 或，遺棄，棄絕。直譯，撇下（在惡劣的困境中）。
footnotes.en: 4:9 2 abandoned Or, deserted, forsaken; lit., left behind (in some terrible plight).

footnotes.zh: 与3节者同。即被杀死。
footnotes.zh_big5: 與3節者同。即被殺死。
footnotes.en: 4:9 3 cast Or, struck down.

refs.text_gb: 逼迫、苦难，就是我在安提阿、以哥念、路司得所遭遇的；我所忍受的是何等的逼迫，但从这一切之中，主都把我救出来了。
refs.text_big5: 逼迫、苦難，就是我在安提阿、以哥念、路司得所遭遇的；我所忍受的是何等的逼迫，但從這一切之中，主都把我救出來了。
refs.text_en: Persecutions, sufferings, such as befell me in Antioch, in Iconium, in Lystra. Such persecutions I bore, and out of them all the Lord delivered me.

refs.text_gb: 不但如此，凡立志在基督耶稣里过敬虔生活的，也都要受逼迫。
refs.text_big5: 不但如此，凡立志在基督耶穌裏過敬虔生活的，也都要受逼迫。
refs.text_en: And indeed all who desire to live godly in Christ Jesus will be persecuted.

refs.text_gb: 为义受逼迫的人有福了，因为诸天的国是他们的。
refs.text_big5: 為義受逼迫的人有福了，因為諸天的國是他們的。
refs.text_en: Blessed are those who are persecuted for the sake of righteousness, for theirs is the kingdom of the heavens.

refs.text_gb: 人若因我的缘故，辱骂你们，逼迫你们，捏造各样坏话毁谤你们，你们就有福了。
refs.text_big5: 人若因我的緣故，辱罵你們，逼迫你們，捏造各樣壞話毀謗你們，你們就有福了。
refs.text_en: Blessed are you when they reproach and persecute you, and while speaking lies, say every evil thing against you because of Me.

refs.text_gb: 应当喜乐欢腾，因为你们在诸天之上的赏赐是大的；原来在你们以前的申言者，人也是这样逼迫他们。
refs.text_big5: 應當喜樂歡騰，因為你們在諸天之上的賞賜是大的；原來在你們以前的申言者，人也是這樣逼迫他們。
refs.text_en: Rejoice and exult, for your reward is great in the heavens; for so they persecuted the prophets who were before you.

refs.text_gb: 就在那日，在耶路撒冷的召会大遭逼迫，除了使徒以外，门徒都分散在犹太和撒玛利亚各地。
refs.text_big5: 就在那日，在耶路撒冷的召會大遭逼迫，除了使徒以外，門徒都分散在猶太和撒瑪利亞各地。
refs.text_en: And Saul approved of his killing. And there occurred in that day a great persecution against the church which was in Jerusalem; and all were scattered throughout the regions of Judea and Samaria, except the apostles.

refs.text_gb: 扫罗却残害召会，逐家进去，连男带女拉去下在监里。
refs.text_big5: 掃羅卻殘害召會，逐家進去，連男帶女拉去下在監裏。
refs.text_en: But Saul was devastating the church, entering house after house; and dragging off men and women, he delivered them to prison.

refs.text_gb: 你们听过我从前在犹太教中所行的事，怎样极力逼迫神的召会，并损毁神的召会。
refs.text_big5: 你們聽過我從前在猶太教中所行的事，怎樣極力逼迫神的召會，並損毀神的召會。
refs.text_en: For you have heard of my manner of life formerly in Judaism, that I persecuted the church of God excessively and ravaged it.

refs.text_gb: 不过听说，那从前一直逼迫他们的，现在将他原先所损毁的信仰当作福音传扬。
refs.text_big5: 不過聽說，那從前一直逼迫他們的，現在將他原先所損毀的信仰當作福音傳揚。
refs.text_en: But they only heard this: He who was formerly persecuting us is now announcing as the gospel the faith which formerly he ravaged.

refs.text_gb: 我从前是亵渎神的、逼迫人的、侮慢人的；然而我蒙了怜悯，因我是在不信中，无知而作的。
refs.text_big5: 我從前是褻瀆神的、逼迫人的、侮慢人的；然而我蒙了憐憫，因我是在不信中，無知而作的。
refs.text_en: Who formerly was a blasphemer and a persecutor and an insulting person; but I was shown mercy because, being ignorant, I acted in unbelief.

refs.text_gb: 你们生活为人不可贪爱钱财，要以现有的为足；因为主曾说，“我绝不撇下你，也绝不丢弃你。”
refs.text_big5: 你們生活為人不可貪愛錢財，要以現有的為足；因為主曾說，“我絕不撇下你，也絕不丟棄你。”
refs.text_en: Let your way of life be without the love of money, being satisfied with the things which are at hand; for He Himself has said, "I shall by no means give you up, neither by any means shall I abandon you";

refs.text_gb: 因为义人虽七次跌倒，仍必兴起，恶人却被祸患倾覆。
refs.text_big5: 因為義人雖七次跌倒，仍必興起，惡人卻被禍患傾覆。
refs.text_en: For a righteous man falls seven times and rises up again, / But the wicked are overthrown by calamity.

refs.text_gb: 我的仇敌啊，不要向我夸耀；我虽跌倒，却要起来；我虽坐在黑暗里，耶和华却是我的光。
refs.text_big5: 我的仇敵阿，不要向我誇耀；我雖跌倒，卻要起來；我雖坐在黑暗裏，耶和華卻是我的光。
refs.text_en: Do not rejoice against me, O my enemy; / When I fall, I will rise up; / When I sit in the darkness, / Jehovah will be a light to me.

verses.text_gb: [Cra]身体上常带着耶稣的[Fn1][Crb]治[Crc]死，[Fn2]使耶稣的[Fn3]生命也显明在我们的身体上。
verses.text_big5: [Cra]身體上常帶著耶穌的[Fn1][Crb]治[Crc]死，[Fn2]使耶穌的[Fn3]生命也顯明在我們的身體上。
verses.text_en: Always bearing about in the body the putting to death of Jesus that the life of Jesus also may be manifested in our body.
verses.text_gb_plain: 身体上常带着耶稣的治死，使耶稣的生命也显明在我们的身体上。
verses.text_big5_plain: 身體上常帶著耶穌的治死，使耶穌的生命也顯明在我們的身體上。

footnotes.zh: 即杀死，致死，指死的工作，十字架的工作，就是主耶稣所遭受、所经过的。在我们的经历中，这是为着耶稣、为着基督的身体并为着新约的职事，所临到我们的苦难、逼迫或对付。这不是指人类在旧造中所共受的苦难、难处，如疾病或灾害；也不是指因着罪过、错误或未尽责任所受的处罚、改正或管教。耶稣的治死，毁坏我们天然的人、外面的人和肉体，使我们里面的人有机会发展并更新(16)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 即殺死，致死，指死的工作，十字架的工作，就是主耶穌所遭受、所經過的。在我們的經歷中，這是為著耶穌、為著基督的身體、並為著新約的職事，所臨到我們的苦難、逼迫或對付。這不是指人類在舊造中所共受的苦難、難處，如疾病或災害；也不是指因著罪過、錯誤或未盡責任所受的處罰、改正或管教。耶穌的治死，毀壞我們天然的人、外面的人和肉體，使我們裏面的人有機會發展並更新。（16。）
footnotes.en: 4:10 1 putting I.e., the killing, the deadening; referring to the working of death, the working of the cross, which the Lord Jesus suffered and went through. In our experience this is a kind of suffering, persecution, or dealing that comes upon us for the sake of Jesus, for the sake of the Body of Christ, and for the sake of the new covenant ministry. This does not refer to sufferings and troubles that are common to all human beings in the old creation, such as illness or calamity, or to punishment, correction, or discipline suffered because of sins, mistakes, or failure to fulfill one's responsibility. This putting to death of Jesus consumes our natural man, our outward man, our flesh, so that our inward man may have the opportunity to develop and be renewed (v. 16).

footnotes.zh: 意，为使，结果。十字架的杀死，结果叫复活的生命显明。这种日常的杀死，是要在复活里释放出神的生命。
footnotes.zh_big5: 意，為使，結果。十字架的殺死，結果叫復活的生命顯明。這種日常的殺死，是要在復活裏釋放出神的生命。
footnotes.en: 4:10 2 that In order that, with the result that. The killing of the cross results in the manifestation of the resurrection life. This daily killing is for the release of the divine life in resurrection.

footnotes.zh: 即复活的生命，就是主耶稣借着十字架的工作，所活并所显出的。
footnotes.zh_big5: 即復活的生命，就是主耶穌藉著十字架的工作，所活並所顯出的。
footnotes.en: 4:10 3 life The resurrection life, which the Lord Jesus lived and expressed through the working of the cross.

refs.text_gb: 这是照着我所专切期待并盼望的，就是没有一事会叫我羞愧，只要凡事放胆，无论是生，是死，总叫基督在我身体上，现今也照常显大，
refs.text_big5: 這是照著我所專切期待並盼望的，就是沒有一事會叫我羞愧，只要凡事放膽，無論是生，是死，總叫基督在我身體上，現今也照常顯大，
refs.text_en: According to my earnest expectation and hope that in nothing I will be put to shame, but with all boldness, as always, even now Christ will be magnified in my body, whether through life or through death.

refs.text_gb: 如经上所记：“我们为你的缘故，终日被杀，人看我们如将宰的羊。”
refs.text_big5: 如經上所記：“我們為你的緣故，終日被殺，人看我們如將宰的羊。”
refs.text_en: As it is written, "For Your sake we are being put to death all day long; we have been accounted as sheep for slaughter."

refs.text_big5: 我們若在祂死的樣式裏與祂聯合生長，也必要在祂復活的樣式裏與祂聯合生長；
refs.text_en: For if we have grown together with Him in the likeness of His death, indeed we will also be in the likeness of His resurrection,

refs.text_big5: 我們若與基督同死，就信也必與祂同活，
refs.text_en: Now if we have died with Christ, we believe that we will also live with Him,

refs.text_en: To know Him and the power of His resurrection and the fellowship of His sufferings, being conformed to His death,

verses.text_gb: 因为我们这活着的人，是常为耶稣被交于[Cra]死，使[Fn1]耶稣的[Crb]生命，也在我们这[Crc]必死的[Fn2]肉身上显明出来。
verses.text_big5: 因為我們這活著的人，是常為耶穌被交於[Cra]死，使[Fn1]耶穌的[Crb]生命，也在我們這[Crc]必死的[Fn2]肉身上顯明出來。
verses.text_en: For we who are alive are always being delivered unto death for Jesus' sake that the life of Jesus also may be manifested in our mortal flesh.
verses.text_gb_plain: 因为我们这活着的人，是常为耶稣被交于死，使耶稣的生命，也在我们这必死的肉身上显明出来。
verses.text_big5_plain: 因為我們這活著的人，是常為耶穌被交於死，使耶穌的生命，也在我們這必死的肉身上顯明出來。

footnotes.zh: 在这两节，耶稣的名称，含示使徒所过的生活，和主耶稣在地上所过的一样。这是在十字架的杀死之下，使复活生命显明的生活。这样的生活，使主自己与祂的职事是一，祂的生活就是祂的职事(约六14～15，十二13，19，23～24)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 在這兩節，耶穌的名稱，含示使徒所過的生活，和主耶穌在地上所過的一樣。這是在十字架的殺死之下，使復活生命顯明的生活。這樣的生活，使主自己與祂的職事是一，祂的生活就是祂的職事。（約六14～15，十二13，19，23～24。）
footnotes.en: 4:11 1 Jesus The title Jesus in these two verses implies that the apostles lived a life like the one the Lord Jesus lived on earth. The Lord's life was a life under the killing of the cross for the manifestation of the resurrection life, a life lived in such a way that His person was one with His ministry and His life was His ministry (John 6:14-15; 12:13, 19, 23-24).

footnotes.zh: 在10～11节，肉身和身体交互使用，指明必死的肉身，就是我们堕落的身体。
footnotes.zh_big5: 在10～11節，肉身和身體交互使用，指明必死的肉身，就是我們墮落的身體。
footnotes.en: 4:11 2 flesh The use of flesh and body interchangeably in vv. 10-11 indicates that our mortal flesh is our fallen body.

footnotes.zh: 意与本节引用的话里所显明同样的灵。
footnotes.zh_big5: 意與本節引用的話裏所顯明同樣的靈。
footnotes.en: 4:13 1 same The same spirit as set forth in the words quoted later in this verse.

footnotes.zh: “不明确是圣灵，也不仅是人的性质，乃是内住的圣灵渗透整个更新的人，并成为这整个新人的特征。”(Alford，阿福德。)“信心的灵，不明确是圣灵，也不是人的机能或性质，乃是二者的搀调，”(Vincent，文生)，就是圣灵与人灵的调和。我们必须像作诗的人，运用这样的灵，信并且说我们所经历于主的事，特别是祂的死和复活。信心不是在我们的心思里，乃是在我们那与圣灵调和的灵里。怀疑才是在我们的心思里。这里的“灵”指明使徒是借着调和的灵，在复活里过钉十字架的生活，以完成他们的职事。
footnotes.zh_big5: “不明確是聖靈，也不僅是人的性質，乃是內住的聖靈滲透整個更新的人，並成為這整個新人的特徵。”（Alford，阿福德。）“信心的靈，不明確是聖靈，也不是人的機能或性質，乃是二者的攙調，”（Vincent，文生，）就是聖靈與人靈的調和。我們必須像作詩的人，運用這樣的靈，信並且說我們所經歷於主的事，特別是祂的死和復活。信心不是在我們的心思裏，乃是在我們那與聖靈調和的靈裏。懷疑纔是在我們的心思裏。這裏的“靈”指明使徒是藉著調和的靈，在復活裏過釘十字架的生活，以完成他們的職事。
footnotes.en: 4:13 2 spirit "Not distinctly the Holy Spirit, — but still not merely a human disposition: the indwelling Holy Spirit penetrates and characterizes the whole renewed man" (Alford). "Spirit of faith: not distinctly the Holy Spirit, nor, on the other hand, a human faculty or disposition, but blending both" (Vincent). The spirit of faith is the Holy Spirit mingled with our human spirit. We must exercise such a spirit to believe and to speak, like the psalmist, the things we have experienced of the Lord, especially His death and resurrection. Faith is in our spirit, which is mingled with the Holy Spirit, not in our mind. Doubts are in our mind. Here spirit indicates that it is by the mingled spirit that the apostles lived a crucified life in resurrection for the carrying out of their ministry.

refs.text_en: For the mind set on the flesh is death, but the mind set on the spirit is life and peace.

verses.text_gb: 知道那[Cra]叫主耶稣复活的，也必叫我们与耶稣一同[Fn1][Crb]复活，并且叫我们与你们一同[Crc]站在祂面前。
verses.text_big5: 知道那[Cra]叫主耶穌復活的，也必叫我們與耶穌一同[Fn1][Crb]復活，並且叫我們與你們一同[Crc]站在祂面前。
verses.text_en: Knowing that He who raised the Lord Jesus will raise us also with Jesus and will make us stand before Him with you.
verses.text_gb_plain: 知道那叫主耶稣复活的，也必叫我们与耶稣一同复活，并且叫我们与你们一同站在祂面前。
verses.text_big5_plain: 知道那叫主耶穌復活的，也必叫我們與耶穌一同復活，並且叫我們與你們一同站在祂面前。

footnotes.zh: 这指明使徒认为自己是死了的人(一9)，因为他们是常为主的定旨被交于死(11)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這指明使徒認為自己是死了的人，（一9，）因為他們是常為主的定旨被交於死。（11。）
footnotes.en: 4:14 1 raise This indicates that the apostles considered themselves dead persons (2 Cor. 1:9), for they were always being delivered unto death for the Lord's purpose (v. 11).

refs.text_gb: 神却将死的痛苦解除，叫祂复活了，因为祂不能被死拘禁。
refs.text_big5: 神卻將死的痛苦解除，叫祂復活了，因為祂不能被死拘禁。
refs.text_en: Whom God has raised up, having loosed the pangs of death, since it was not possible for Him to be held by it.

refs.text_gb: 并且神已经使主复活，也必借着祂的能力，使我们复活起来。
refs.text_big5: 並且神已經使主復活，也必藉著祂的能力，使我們復活起來。
refs.text_en: And God has both raised up the Lord and will raise us up through His power.

refs.text_gb: 自己里面也断定是必死的，叫我们不信靠自己，只信靠那叫死人复活的神；
refs.text_big5: 自己裏面也斷定是必死的，叫我們不信靠自己，只信靠那叫死人復活的神；
refs.text_en: Indeed we ourselves had the response of death in ourselves, that we should not base our confidence on ourselves but on God, who raises the dead;

refs.text_gb: 就是在一刹那，眨眼之间，末次号筒的时候；因号筒要响，死人要复活，成为不朽坏的，我们也要改变。
refs.text_big5: 就是在一剎那，眨眼之間，末次號筒的時候；因號筒要響，死人要復活，成為不朽壞的，我們也要改變。
refs.text_en: In a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trumpet; for the trumpet will sound, and the dead will be raised incorruptible, and we will be changed.

refs.text_gb: 因为我们若信耶稣死而复活了，神也必照样将那些已经借着耶稣睡了的人与祂一同带来。
refs.text_big5: 因為我們若信耶穌死而復活了，神也必照樣將那些已經藉著耶穌睡了的人與祂一同帶來。
refs.text_en: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose, so also those who have fallen asleep through Jesus, God will bring with Him.

refs.text_gb: 因为主必亲自从天降临，有发令的呼叫，有天使长的声音，又有神的号声，那在基督里死了的人必先复活，

refs.text_en: Because the Lord Himself, with a shout of command, with the voice of the archangel and with the trumpet of God, will descend from heaven, and the dead in Christ will rise first.

refs.text_gb: 但如今祂在基督肉体的身体里，借着死，叫你们与自己和好了，把你们圣别、没有瑕疵、无可责备的呈献在自己面前；

refs.text_en: He now has reconciled in the body of His flesh through death, to present you holy and without blemish and without reproach before Him;

refs.text_big5: 我們宣揚祂，是用全般的智慧警戒各人，教導各人，好將各人在基督裏成熟的獻上；
refs.text_en: Whom we announce, admonishing every man and teaching every man in all wisdom that we may present every man full-grown in Christ;

verses.text_gb: 因为[Cra]凡事都是[Crb]为你们，好叫[Fn1][Crc]恩典借着更多的人而增多，使[Crd]感谢洋溢，以致[Cre]荣耀归与神。

refs.text_gb: 还有，我们晓得万有都互相效力，叫爱神的人得益处，就是按祂旨意被召的人。

refs.text_en: And we know that all things work together for good to those who love God, to those who are called according to His purpose.

refs.text_gb: 我们或是受患难，是为了你们受安慰，得拯救；或是受安慰，也是为了你们受安慰；这安慰叫你们能忍受我们所受的同样苦难。
refs.text_big5: 我們或是受患難，是為了你們受安慰，得拯救；或是受安慰，也是為了你們受安慰；這安慰叫你們能忍受我們所受的同樣苦難。
refs.text_en: But whether we are afflicted, it is for your comforting and salvation; or whether we are comforted, it is for your comforting, which operates in the endurance of the same sufferings which we also suffer.

refs.text_gb: 因我们或是癫狂，乃是向着神；或是谨守，乃是为着你们。
refs.text_big5: 因我們或是癲狂，乃是向著神；或是謹守，乃是為著你們。
refs.text_en: For whether we were beside ourselves, it was to God; or whether we are sober-minded, it is for you.

refs.text_gb: 只要你们也为着我们以祈求配合帮助，好叫许多人因我们借着许多人所得的恩赐，为我们献上感谢。
refs.text_big5: 只要你們也為著我們以祈求配合幫助，好叫許多人因我們藉著許多人所得的恩賜，為我們獻上感謝。
refs.text_en: If you also help in this by petition on our behalf, that for the gift to us through many, thanks may be given by many persons on our behalf.

refs.text_gb: 然而因着神的恩，我成了我今天这个人，并且神的恩临到我，不是徒然的；反而我比众使徒格外劳苦，但这不是我，乃是神的恩与我同在。
refs.text_big5: 然而因著神的恩，我成了我今天這個人，並且神的恩臨到我，不是徒然的；反而我比眾使徒格外勞苦，但這不是我，乃是神的恩與我同在。
refs.text_en: But by the grace of God I am what I am; and His grace unto me did not turn out to be in vain, but, on the contrary, I labored more abundantly than all of them, yet not I but the grace of God which is with me.

refs.text_gb: 使你们凡事富足，以致十分慷慨，就借着我们对神生出感谢；
refs.text_big5: 使你們凡事富足，以致十分慷慨，就藉著我們對神生出感謝；
refs.text_en: You in everything are being enriched unto all liberality, which works out through us thanksgiving to God,

refs.text_gb: 因为这服事的供应，不但补足圣徒的缺乏，也借着许多对神的感谢而洋溢。
refs.text_big5: 因為這服事的供應，不但補足聖徒的缺乏，也藉著許多對神的感謝而洋溢。
refs.text_en: Because the ministry of this service is not only filling up the lack of the saints, but is also abounding through many thanksgivings to God.

refs.text_gb: 因为神的应许，不论有多少，在基督里都是是的，所以借着祂，对神也都是阿们的，好叫荣耀借着我们归与神。
refs.text_big5: 因為神的應許，不論有多少，在基督裏都是是的，所以藉著祂，對神也都是阿們的，好叫榮耀藉著我們歸與神。
refs.text_en: For as many promises of God as there are, in Him is the Yes; therefore also through Him is the Amen to God, for glory through us to God.

refs.text_gb: 不但这样，他也被众召会选出，在我们所服事的这恩典上，和我们同行，是为着主自己的荣耀，也是为着我们的热切。
refs.text_big5: 不但這樣，他也被眾召會選出，在我們所服事的這恩典上，和我們同行，是為著主自己的榮耀，也是為著我們的熱切。
refs.text_en: And not only this, but who has also been selected by the churches as our fellow traveler in this grace which is being ministered by us, to the glory of the Lord Himself and to demonstrate our eagerness;

verses.text_gb: 所以我们[Cra]不丧胆，反而我们[Fn1][Crb]外面的人虽然在[Fn2]毁坏，我们[Crc]里面的人却日日在[Fn3][Crd]更新。
verses.text_big5: 所以我們[Cra]不喪膽，反而我們[Fn1][Crb]外面的人雖然在[Fn2]毀壞，我們[Crc]裏面的人卻日日在[Fn3][Crd]更新。
verses.text_en: Therefore we do not lose heart; but though our outer man is decaying, yet our inner man is being renewed day by day.
verses.text_gb_plain: 所以我们不丧胆，反而我们外面的人虽然在毁坏，我们里面的人却日日在更新。
verses.text_big5_plain: 所以我們不喪膽，反而我們外面的人雖然在毀壞，我們裏面的人卻日日在更新。

footnotes.zh: 外面的人是以我们的身体为其器官，以我们的魂为其生命和人位。里面的人是以我们重生的灵为其生命和人位，以我们更新的魂为其器官。魂的生命必须被否认(太十六24～25)，但魂的功用——心思、意志、情感，必须借着被征服(十4～5)，得着更新并提高，而为灵所用；灵乃是里面之人的人位。
footnotes.en: 4:16 1 inner The outer man consists of the body as its organ with the soul as its life and person. The inner man consists of the regenerated spirit as its life and person with the renewed soul as its organ. The life of the soul must be denied (Matt. 16:24-25), but the faculties of the soul — the mind, will, and emotion — must be renewed and uplifted by being subdued (1 Cor. 10:4-5) so that they can be used by the spirit, the person of the inner man.

footnotes.zh: 或，销毁，消耗，磨损。借着不断地杀死——死的工作，我们外面的人，就是我们物质的身体，以及使其有生命的魂(林前十五44与注)，就渐渐销毁磨损。
footnotes.zh_big5: 或，銷毀，消耗，磨損。藉著不斷的殺死─死的工作，我們外面的人，就是我們物質的身體，以及使其有生命的魂，（林前十五44與註，）就漸漸銷毀磨損。
footnotes.en: 4:16 2 decaying Or, being consumed, being wasted away, being worn out. By the continued killing, the working of death, our outer man, that is, our material body with its animating soul (1 Cor. 15:44 and note), is being consumed and worn out.

footnotes.zh: 指因复活生命新鲜的供应得着滋养，而得以更新。我们外面的人，我们必死的身体，因着死的杀死工作逐渐销毁；我们里面的人，就是我们重生的灵，连同我们里面的各部分(耶三一33，来八10，罗七22，25)，却因复活生命的供应，得以日日新陈代谢的更新。
footnotes.zh_big5: 指因復活生命新鮮的供應得著滋養，而得以更新。我們外面的人，我們必死的身體，因著死的殺死工作逐漸銷毀；我們裏面的人，就是我們重生的靈，連同我們裏面的各部分，（耶三一33，來八10，羅七22，25，）卻因復活生命的供應，得以日日新陳代謝的更新。
footnotes.en: 4:16 3 renewed By being nourished with the fresh supply of the resurrection life. As our mortal body, our outer man, is being consumed by the killing work of death, our inner man, that is, our regenerated spirit with the inward parts of our being (Jer. 31:33; Heb. 8:10; Rom. 7:22, 25), is being metabolically renewed day by day with the supply of the resurrection life.

refs.text_gb: 因此，我们既照所蒙的怜悯，受了这职事，就不丧胆，
refs.text_big5: 因此，我們既照所蒙的憐憫，受了這職事，就不喪膽，
refs.text_en: Therefore having this ministry as we have been shown mercy, we do not lose heart;

refs.text_gb: 知道我们的旧人已经与祂同钉十字架，使罪的身体失效，叫我们不再作罪的奴仆，
refs.text_big5: 知道我們的舊人已經與祂同釘十字架，使罪的身體失效，叫我們不再作罪的奴僕，
refs.text_en: Knowing this, that our old man has been crucified with Him in order that the body of sin might be annulled, that we should no longer serve sin as slaves;

refs.text_gb: 在从前的生活样式上，脱去了旧人，这旧人是照着那迷惑的情欲败坏的；
refs.text_big5: 在從前的生活樣式上，脫去了舊人，這舊人是照著那迷惑的情慾敗壞的；
refs.text_en: That you put off, as regards your former manner of life, the old man, which is being corrupted according to the lusts of the deceit,

refs.text_big5: 不要彼此說謊，因你們已經脫去舊人，同舊人的行為，
refs.text_en: Do not lie to one another, since you have put off the old man with his practices

refs.text_gb: 愿祂照着祂荣耀的丰富，借着祂的灵，用大能使你们得以加强到里面的人里，
refs.text_big5: 願祂照著祂榮耀的豐富，藉著祂的靈，用大能使你們得以加強到裏面的人裏，
refs.text_en: That He would grant you, according to the riches of His glory, to be strengthened with power through His Spirit into the inner man,

refs.text_gb: 并且穿上了新人，这新人是照着神，在那实际的义和圣中所创造的。
refs.text_big5: 並且穿上了新人，這新人是照著神，在那實際的義和聖中所創造的。
refs.text_en: And put on the new man, which was created according to God in righteousness and holiness of the reality.

refs.text_gb: 并且穿上了新人；这新人照着创造他者的形像渐渐更新，以致有充足的知识；
refs.text_big5: 並且穿上了新人；這新人照著創造他者的形像漸漸更新，以致有充足的知識；
refs.text_en: And have put on the new man, which is being renewed unto full knowledge according to the image of Him who created him,

refs.text_big5: 不要模倣這世代，反要藉著心思的更新而變化，叫你們驗證何為神那美好、可喜悅、並純全的旨意。
refs.text_en: And do not be fashioned according to this age, but be transformed by the renewing of the mind that you may prove what the will of God is, that which is good and well pleasing and perfect.

refs.text_gb: 而在你们心思的灵里得以更新，
refs.text_big5: 而在你們心思的靈裏得以更新，
refs.text_en: And that you be renewed in the spirit of your mind

refs.text_gb: 并且穿上了新人；这新人照着创造他者的形像渐渐更新，以致有充足的知识；
refs.text_big5: 並且穿上了新人；這新人照著創造他者的形像漸漸更新，以致有充足的知識；
refs.text_en: And have put on the new man, which is being renewed unto full knowledge according to the image of Him who created him,

refs.text_big5: 祂便救了我們，並不是本於我們所成就的義行，乃是照著祂的憐憫，藉著重生的洗滌，和聖靈的更新。
